verdict.rationale: Cubic clearly supports kicking off reviews from GitHub (auto-review on PR open, and via '@cubic-dev-ai review this PR' comment), but there is no evidence of GitLab, Linear, or Slack integration — in fact community comments explicitly ask for GitLab support and note lack of it, and question direct GitHub integration parity with competitors. missing for 10: GitLab support, Linear integration, Slack integration, and independent confirmation these trigger agent tasks.
